PC: Requests additional history (e.g., prior Emergency Department course and exam, results of head imaging, and therapies administered prior to arrival).
Performs or delegates focused neurologic exam (mental status, cranial nerve exam, gross motor function of extremities, and reflexes).
Proceeds with intubation for airway control.
Performs interventions to acutely decrease intracranial pressure (e.g. head of bed elevation and hyperosmolar therapy).
MK: Identifies acute coma and signs of impending herniation.
